command.reticulum.ambiguous_network: More than one network goes by that — use more of its id (/reticulum list shows them)
command.reticulum.merge_has_controller: %s still has a working controller — break it first
command.reticulum.unknown_network: No network with that name or id
command.reticulum.unknown_role: Role must be viewer, user, editor or admin
message.reticulum.already_member_role: You're already a member of %s — an admin can change your role
message.reticulum.ambiguous_placement: Touches several networks — connect one with the tool or cable screen
message.reticulum.beacon_dye_nothing: Nothing is showing — a dye recolors what the beacon shows now
message.reticulum.controller_exists: %s already has a controller — this one starts a new network
message.reticulum.controller_reconnected: Took over %s, which had lost its controller
message.reticulum.editor_focused: Switched the open Reticulum editor to this network
message.reticulum.editor_link_hover: Click to open the editor in your browser
message.reticulum.editor_opened: Opened the Reticulum editor in your browser: %s
message.reticulum.leads_to_controller: Its cable leads to %s's controller — connect it to the other network's cable instead
message.reticulum.merge_needs_owner: That would merge %s in — only its owner can
message.reticulum.network_claimed: %s had no owner — it is yours now. Use the controller again to open it.
message.reticulum.network_claimed_public: %s had no owner — it is yours now. It's public: anyone can join blocks to it. Make it private in its settings (in the editor). Use the controller again to open it.
message.reticulum.network_gone: The remembered network no longer exists — starting a new one
message.reticulum.no_admin_access: Only the network's admins can do that
message.reticulum.no_edit_access: You don't have edit access to this network
message.reticulum.not_a_connector: Only connectors can be bound to a network
message.reticulum.not_a_device: That side has no connected device
message.reticulum.not_a_device_of_yours: That block isn't a device of a network you can use
message.reticulum.not_facade_block: %s can't be a facade: only full blocks without a block entity
message.reticulum.nothing_to_connect: Nothing to connect on that side
message.reticulum.password_required: Set a password before choosing Password access
message.reticulum.password_too_soon: Wait a moment before setting the password again
message.reticulum.piece_moved: Connected — this piece moved from %s to %s
message.reticulum.protected: %s is private — only members can break its blocks
message.reticulum.protected_private: This network is private — only members can break its blocks
message.reticulum.save_unreadable: Reticulum couldn't read all of its saved networks — a copy was kept as %s (in the world's data folder). Those networks start empty; avoid rebuilding them until it's sorted.
message.reticulum.stack_bound: Bound %s connector(s) to %s — place them where no cable joins them
message.reticulum.too_many_members: A network can have at most %s members
message.reticulum.tool_empty: No network yet — sneak + right-click a controller or connector
message.reticulum.two_controllers: Can't connect: both sides have a controller
message.reticulum.wired_connector: Its cable decides its network — disconnect it to rebind

screen.reticulum.alarm_none: Nothing is going off on your networks
screen.reticulum.alarm_sound_every_hint: A two-tone siren takes 2 seconds, so it repeats every 2 at the most
screen.reticulum.attached_tip: Attached: the network uses this device. Click to detach it.
screen.reticulum.beacon_beam_hint: A beam up to the sky and down to the bottom of the world
screen.reticulum.beacon_beam_through_hin: The beam goes on through solid blocks (otherwise it stops at the first)
screen.reticulum.beacon_glow_hint: A pulsing glow around the beacon
screen.reticulum.beacon_glow_through_hin: The glow shows through walls and floors
screen.reticulum.beacon_label_hint_redst: Its text, shown above the beacon
screen.reticulum.beacon_mode_hint_networ: Shows the worst alarm on the network of the connector it is attached to
screen.reticulum.beacon_mode_hint_redsto: Shows a look for the signal it gets, set per level below (0 is no signal) — by default 1 to 7 yellow, 8 to 15 red (an Alarm node gives 7 for a warning, 15 for critical)
screen.reticulum.beacon_read_only: Only its network's users can change it
screen.reticulum.beacon_sound_hint: The sound below, every so many ticks
screen.reticulum.beacon_text_color_auto_: Automatic: the beacon's color for its text, the alarm's color (amber or red) for alarms
screen.reticulum.beacon_text_color_hint: The text's color, as #RRGGBB. Blank: the beacon's color for its text, the alarm's color (amber or red) for alarms.
screen.reticulum.beacon_text_hint: Text above the beacon: the text below, or (Network mode, left blank) the alarms going off
screen.reticulum.beacon_text_through_hin: The text shows through walls and floors
screen.reticulum.beacon_two_tone_hint: Every other play is lower, like a siren
screen.reticulum.detached_tip: Detached: the network leaves this device alone. Click to attach it.
screen.reticulum.editor_fullscreen: The editor can't show over fullscreen
screen.reticulum.editor_fullscreen_hint: Press F11 for windowed mode, or use Open in browser
screen.reticulum.facade_hint: Click a block to paint the stack. Sneak + right-click a block in the world to copy it exactly.
screen.reticulum.facade_hint_jei: Click a block to paint the stack, or drag one from JEI onto the box above. Sneak + right-click a block in the world to copy it exactly.
screen.reticulum.identify_on: Light it up in the world until turned off
screen.reticulum.joint.conflict_tip: Network conflict: the two sides belong to different networks. Click to join them into the one with the controller (not possible when both have one).
screen.reticulum.joint.connected_tip: Connected. Click to disconnect this side.
screen.reticulum.joint.disconnected_tip: Disconnected. Click to connect this side.
screen.reticulum.no_sheets: No sheets yet: open the editor to make one
screen.reticulum.rebind_controller: Its cable leads to a controller — connect it to the other network's cable instead
screen.reticulum.rebind_piece: Moves this piece of cable (%s blocks) and its connectors to the network you pick
screen.reticulum.rebind_unwire: Disconnects its cable and binds it on its own to the network you pick
screen.reticulum.rebind_wireless: Binds it to the network you pick
screen.reticulum.redstone_hint: What redstone into this controller does to the whole network: nothing, run only while powered, or stop while powered.
screen.reticulum.stopped_redstone: Not running (redstone, or the controller isn't loaded)
tooltip.reticulum.antenna_use: Right-click a controller to install it — take it out with the network tool (Configure mode, sneak + right-click)
tooltip.reticulum.facade: Right-click a cable or connector to make it look like this block. Take it off with the network tool (Configure mode, sneak + right-click).
tooltip.reticulum.facade_paint: Right-click to choose any block for the whole stack — sneak + right-click a block to copy how it looks
tooltip.reticulum.tool_configure: Right-click a joint to connect or disconnect it, or a device side to attach or detach it. Sneak + right-click takes off a facade, or a controller's antenna
tooltip.reticulum.tool_identify: Right-click a connector or device to light it up (or off) — sneak + right-click lights one face of a device
tooltip.reticulum.tool_link: Sneak + right-click a controller or connector to copy its network. Right-click a connector to bind it. Right-click the air to pick a network (or unlink the tool)
tooltip.reticulum.tool_status: Held, marks blocks with something wrong, through walls — right-click the air to choose what the tool does about alarms
tooltip.reticulum.tool_switch: Sneak + scroll to switch mode — sneak + right-click the air to open the editor
